summary: Train/eval offline tokenization and all pair audits passed. The unchanged 3.93M dynamics arm emitted finite metrics through 62,601 updates before an external DSW stop. After explicit user authorization, the same frozen runner restored the retained step-50k checkpoint as a new attempt, replayed the unavoidable overlap and has now reached 110,597/200,000 finite updates with fixed validation through 110k and a step-100k checkpoint.

deviations.reason: Offline tokenization owns immutable metadata.json rather than training runtime-identity.json/run-state.json; the generic training recorder was therefore the wrong wrapper for this preprocessing child.
deviations.verification: A precise runner regression was red before removing the generic recorder and green afterward.

deviations.reason: The external timer interruption occurred after update 62,601, but the newest durable Orbax checkpoint was step 50,000. Explicit user authorization requested continuing the same experiment.
deviations.accounting: The new attempt_id separates replayed metrics from the original attempt; terminal claims use the final completed attempt and preserve both histories.

failures.message: The DSW instance was externally stopped while encoding the first train attempt; only a uniquely named incomplete staging directory remained.
recorded command succeeded without runtime-identity.json and run-state.json
The existing DSW shutdown timer became due and stopped the A10. The run had emitted metrics through completed update 62,601, a 60k fixed validation and a step-50k checkpoint.
failures.resolution: Explicitly authorized fault resume from this experiment's own step-50k checkpoint as attempt 9e81f38c-090d-4b59-b11c-669103fa190e.

observed: All 4,096 train and 512 held-out latent records preserve exact categorical actions, rewards, terminals, record indices and source raw-tree identities.
The dynamics run started from scratch from clean detached source ed5ee9d82721ab9e868f900123a44b83315ffdea.
Before the infrastructure interruption, the run emitted finite metrics through 62,601 completed updates, fixed validation videos through 60,001 updates and a durable step-50k checkpoint.
After the same A10 returned to Running, pipeline PID 1794 was dead and the GPU was idle; no automatic training restart occurred.

After explicit user authorization, pipeline PID 944 restored step 50,000 under a new attempt ID. The first retained recovery metric at completed update 50,401 remained finite, and telemetry reported 6.3252 updates/s.

The recovery surpassed the prior 62,601-update high-water mark and reached 110,597/200,000 updates. Fixed validation exists through 110k, checkpoints through step 100k and the latest retained flow MSE remains finite at 0.041015625.
interpretation: The offline representation passed its protocol parity gate and the authorized resume is healthy beyond the interrupted high-water mark. Terminal quality remains pending, the replayed 50,001–62,601 interval must not be counted as unique optimizer progress, and fluctuating periodic shortcut scores must not be interpreted post hoc.
not_established: Whether offline encoding improves dynamics training throughput.
Whether the unchanged 200k dynamics protocol reaches the quality thresholds.
Whether the resumed attempt completes all terminal evaluations.
decision: Continue only the authorized frozen step-50k fault resume through 200k and terminal evaluation; preserve both attempt histories and do not start another arm.
